faq.q: What is the Hawk and Little Morgan Revolver in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a revolver named by Rockstar in the Compare Editions contents on the official Grand Theft Auto VI store page. The listing establishes both the weapon name and Hawk and Little as its manufacturer.

faq.q: Is the Morgan Revolver in the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition?
faq.a: The revolver appears in the store page edition contents beside an item called Personalized Weapon Variants. IGN reported that the Ultimate Edition gives access to special versions of the revolver for both Lucia and Jason.

faq.q: Who makes the Morgan Revolver in GTA 6?
faq.a: Hawk and Little, an in-game manufacturer that Rockstar names directly in the store listing. The manufacturer is part of the official weapon name rather than something worked out from the way the gun looks.

faq.q: How much damage does the Morgan Revolver do?
faq.a: Rockstar has published no damage figure, fire rate, reload speed or magazine capacity for it. The game has not released. Numbers from revolvers in earlier Grand Theft Auto games do not carry over and are not listed here.

faq.q: Where can players buy the Morgan Revolver in GTA 6?
faq.a: No shop, price or unlock method has been published. Rockstar has released no weapons list of any kind, so how the revolver is obtained outside the edition contents is not known.
